mmek001.name: Storm Striker
mmek001.description: A well-balanced assault unit, combining agility with reliable defenses, perfect for leading rapid engagements.
mmek001.appearance: A two-legged mech with a compact torso and twin forearms, featuring electric blue armor panels and exposed energy conduits. Its sleek form balances mobility with reinforced joint housings.

mmek002.name: Titan Vanguard
mmek002.description: A heavily armored frontline warrior, built to soak up enemy fire while delivering devastating counterattacks.
mmek002.appearance: A four-legged combat chassis with thick, layered armor plates and reinforced limb actuators. Its dark gray exterior is accented with red warning markings and heavy weapon mounts.

mmek003.name: Iron Reaver
mmek003.description: A relentless brawler equipped with reinforced plating and heavy-hitting firepower.
mmek003.appearance: A two-legged mech with four heavy arms mounted on its broad torso, each reinforced for close-quarters impact. Gunmetal gray armor is trimmed in orange, with visible hydraulic pistons and shock absorbers.

mmek004.name: Phantom Breaker
mmek004.description: A tactical disruptor, using energy-based attacks to weaken enemy defenses before striking hard.
mmek004.appearance: A two-legged frame with dual arms, wrapped in dark gray armor and lit by blue energy conduits. A tapered hood houses advanced sensors and keeps a low profile.

mmek005.name: Thunder Sentinel
mmek005.description: A steadfast defender designed for prolonged engagements, featuring adaptive shielding and high endurance.
mmek005.appearance: A four-legged defense platform with a broad torso and reinforced armor panels. Deep blue plating is accented by gold trim, and a central shield emitter is housed in a reinforced dome.

mmek006.name: Ember Warden
mmek006.description: A siege specialist armed with incendiary weaponry, ideal for sustained area denial.
mmek006.appearance: A tracked crawler base supporting a tall turret tower with integrated incendiary launchers. Heavy red and black armor plates protect its ammunition feed and combustion chambers.

mmek007.name: Shadow Bastion
mmek007.description: A versatile combat platform capable of adapting to multiple roles with advanced energy defenses.
mmek007.appearance: A two-legged mech with four arms clustered around its torso, each arm designed for modular tool or weapon mounts. Dark armor has subtle glowing patterns, and a sloped hood conceals advanced sensors.

mmek008.name: Cyclone Hunter
mmek008.description: A high-speed interceptor that excels at chasing down vulnerable targets and evading counterattacks.
mmek008.appearance: A two-legged runner with integrated thruster pods and a narrow torso. Its green-and-black armor plates are aerodynamically sculpted, with visible cooling channels along its limbs.

mmek009.name: Avalanche Titan
mmek009.description: A mid-weight powerhouse capable of weathering storms of firepower and striking back with force.
mmek009.appearance: A four-legged heavy chassis with thick armor plates and reinforced limb joints. Steel gray panels are accented with blue highlights, and multiple weapon mounts extend from its broad torso.

mmek010.name: Nova Lancer
mmek010.description: A cutting-edge energy-based Mek with powerful shield regeneration and precision-strike weaponry.
mmek010.appearance: A two-legged mech with four auxiliary arms for weapon mounts and a compact energy core in its torso. Its white-and-blue armor features glowing power conduits and shield emitters.
